breaking_news.headline: Anger as Berlin Pride attacker revealed to have been freed weeks earlier

breaking_news.headline: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars

breaking_news.headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled

breaking_news.headline: Wildfire now nine miles away from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns

breaking_news.headline: Businessman and philanthropist Sir Ian Wood dies aged 84
